cell_aspects.terminal_1x2: cell_width_px equals cell_height_px divided by two

runtime_sampling_domain.raster_admission: Any positive runtime raster is structurally admissible. Raster dimensions need not divide cell dimensions: the logical ANSI address domain uses ceiling division, actual raster dimensions own perspective aspect and splat attachments, and edge-cell scans must bounds-check partial coverage.

camera_zoom.restriction_boundary: These are implemented control bounds and route defaults, not certified shimmer-safe thresholds. Each receipt must record actual camera pose, projection and zoom.

runtime_sampling_domain.capture_identity_rule: One five-frame proof capture has one immutable matrix/raster/cell-aspect identity. A live matrix transition must fail or restart an armed proof request; fixed world/probe captures may survive when their own world-space identity remains valid, while cell/raster-domain resources rebuild.

temporal_regression_requirements.presentation_mode_policy: Operator correction 2026-09-13: FF is the default and sufficient required temporal proof mode. FC/CF/CC are optional diagnostics, not required acceptance arms or substitutes for FF. Prioritize matrix resolution, normal zoom and square 1:1 versus terminal 1:2 text size. Operator decision 2026-09-28 (FL-4896): True FF temporal claims are measured on Saitamaar native text rows (17 px rows; each character's codepoint, pen x, advance and paint) with scripts/measure_true_ff_text_flips.py, never on fixed pixel cells; scripts/measure_f10_churn.py and fixed-cell box annotators are non-True-FF diagnostics.
acceptance_rules: Every route family must carry its own coverage and unresolved gaps. A five-frame result cannot certify unobserved intervals or all possible settings.

In FF, exercise square and terminal cells, all supported matrix steps, normal zoom and declared zoom/raster/probe boundary cases. Record actual dimensions and camera state; record untested combinations rather than infer their safety.
Preserve canonical five-frame artifacts and add continuous companion windows for stop/start, cache retirement, and probe transitions.

Use existing geometry, reprojection, jitter and shimmer detectors; extend missing adapters rather than create a second renderer or proof route. The True FF text-row adapter is scripts/measure_true_ff_text_flips.py.
Treat missing, truncated, stale, unclassified or zero-comparable evidence as incomplete, never as zero defects.
Bound capture, readback, decode, disk output and preservation together. Compression must retain the information needed by every detector and be tested against the original format.
Thresholds require an explicit contract or calibration. Mean sampling density and coarser cells do not certify correct geometry or shimmer freedom.

Temporal jitter and shimmer observations must use frame-exact capture: one PNG entry per rendered game frame plus a single manifest.txt carrying every frame line. Display-rate screen capture containing duplicated frames is not an observation.

True FF temporal observations (FL-4896, operator convention FL-4894): one true_ff.text_frame.v1 export line per rendered frame of one continuous run, classified by scripts/measure_true_ff_text_flips.py. Every delivered temporal media shows its classification as cell borders at native character geometry: RED = a character changed without a displacement explanation (substituted in place or vanished; a flip), YELLOW = a character appeared where the previous frame had no ink nearby; no border = the same glyph moved, scrolled or stayed. The legend text is in the delivered HTML and burned into the GIF. The same-state test (compare) requires identical text for one scene, pose and camera reached by two paths; any RED is history dependence. Its sensitivity controls are a known in-place flip (RED expected) and a known pure translation (no border expected) on the same route.
